name: Pricing and Unit Economics of AI Products
description: An expert course on the economics of AI products. You build a cost-to-serve model from tokens, caching, retrieval, tools and infrastructure, compare seat, usage, credit, hybrid and outcome-based pricing using public examples, design packaging and limits that protect margin, and implement metering and billing with tools such as Stripe Billing, Metronome and Orb.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: Pricing and Unit Economics of AI Products

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 22 lessons in 6 modules; and pass the final exam: 25 questions, 60 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
